dialog.title: Company formation
dialog.description: Notarisation for the formation of a GmbH or UG. Required for entry in the commercial register.
step.gesellschaft.title: Company
field.firmenname.label: Company name (Firma)
field.firmenname.helpText: Must distinguish itself from existing companies. Generic names such as “Craftsmen GmbH” are not allowed.
field.adresse_gesellschaft.label: Business address & registered seat
field.adresse_gesellschaft.helpText: The registered seat is only the municipality – it determines the competent registry court. Activate the toggle if the business address and the seat are identical.
field.unternehmensgegenstand.label: Corporate purpose
field.unternehmensgegenstand.placeholder: e.g. development and distribution of software for the real estate industry
field.unternehmensgegenstand.helpText: Must be meaningful. General wording such as “production of all goods, import and export” is not permitted.
field.ihk_anfrage.label: Preliminary IHK enquiry by the notary
field.ihk_anfrage.helpText: The notary checks the company name and corporate purpose with the Chamber of Industry and Commerce in advance.
step.rechtsform.title: Legal form & capital
field.rechtsform.label: Legal form
field.rechtsform.helpText: For GbR formations, please use the dedicated GbR dialog.
field.gbr_embed.label: GbR data
field.gbr_embed.helpText: For a GbR the fields of the dedicated GbR dialog are embedded here.
field.stammkapital.label: Share capital (EUR)
field.stammkapital.helpText: GmbH: at least EUR 25,000. UG: from EUR 1, EUR 500–2,000 recommended.
field.kapitaleinlage.label: Form of contribution
field.kapitaleinlage_ug.label: Notice
field.kapitaleinlage_ug.text: For a UG (haftungsbeschränkt), only cash contributions are permitted. Contributions in kind are not possible.
field.sacheinlage_info.label: Description of contributions in kind
field.sacheinlage_info.placeholder: e.g. machinery, vehicle, patents – each with value
field.kapitalzahlung.label: Capital payment
field.geschaeftsanteile.label: Denomination of shares
field.satzung.label: Articles of association
field.satzung.helpText: The sample protocol is cheaper but less flexible.
field.satzung.option.Musterprotokoll (nu: Sample protocol (max. 3 founders and 1 managing director)
field.geschaeftsjahr.label: Fiscal year
field.geschaeftsjahr_abweichend.label: Start and end of the fiscal year
step.gruender.title: Founders
field.anzahl_gruender.label: Number of founders / shareholders
field.musterprotokoll_gruender_warnung.t: When using the sample protocol (GmbH/UG), at most 3 founders are permitted. Please reduce the number or choose individual articles.
field.gruender.label: Shareholder
field.gruender.field.anteil.label: Participation (%)
field.gruender.field.anteil.helpText: With only one shareholder the share is 100 %.
field.gruender.field.familienstand.label: Marital status
field.gruender.field.ehevertrag.label: Marriage contract in place?
field.gruender.field.auslandsbeziehung.l: Foreign element (foreign spouse or residence abroad)?
field.gruender.field.geschaeftsfuehrer.l: Will this person be managing director?
field.gruender.field.einzelvertretung.he: Allows the managing director to act with binding effect alone.
field.gruender.field.paragraph_181.label: Exemption from § 181 BGB
field.gruender.field.paragraph_181.helpT: Permits self-dealing (e.g. contracts with oneself in a private capacity).
field.gruender.field.dolmetscher.label: Interpreter required?
field.gruender.field.jp_firmenname.label: Company name
field.gruender.field.jp_rechtsform.label: Legal form
field.gruender.field.jp_sitz.label: Registered seat
step.externe_gf.title: External managing directors & procura
field.externer_gf.label: Should additional external managing directors who are not shareholders be appointed?
field.anzahl_externe_gf.label: Number of external managing directors
field.musterprotokoll_gf_warnung.label: Notice
field.musterprotokoll_gf_warnung.text: With the sample protocol only one managing director is permitted. Please reduce the number or change the form of articles.
field.externe_gf.label: External managing director
field.prokura_erteilen.label: Should procura be granted?
field.anzahl_prokuristen.label: Number of procurists
field.prokuristen.label: Procurist
field.prokuristen.field.grundstuecke_bef: Should the procurist be authorised to dispose of and encumber real estate?
step.weiteres.title: Further details
field.beurkundungsart.label: Type of notarisation
field.beurkundungsart.helpText: Online notarisations have been possible for GmbH formations under certain conditions since 2022. The notary will verify this.
field.bemerkungen.label: Remarks (optional)
field.dokumente.label: Upload documents (optional)
field.dokumente.helpText: E.g. IDs, existing draft articles, in-kind contribution report.
